name: Key Woodworking, Inc.
old_description: Keywood has been serving the DMV area projects since 1992 with passion.
about:
Key Woodworking, Inc. operates from Springfield, Virginia, in the Washington, D.C. metro area. The company was founded in 1992 by a first-generation immigrant who began as a one-man woodworking shop. Through decades of sustained effort, the business has grown into a small but capable firm serving the commercial construction market.

The shop specializes in custom-fabricated premium architectural woodwork, providing engineering services to align fabrication with design intent and managing material procurement from global sources including Europe, Africa, and Asia. Its craftsmen combine extensive experience with modern equipment to execute projects that have reached single-contract values exceeding $2 million, often on compressed schedules.

Key Woodworking focuses on upscale high-rise multi-residential buildings and Class A office towers, along with restaurants and public institutions throughout the DMV region. Past work includes amenity spaces, lobbies, and lounges for prominent developments in the Washington, D.C. area.

The company emphasizes a value set described as honest, hard-working, and innovative, backed by operational practices such as finely tuned scheduling, open communication, and a policy of taking full ownership of each project. These principles, the firm says, differentiate it from competitors and have sustained client relationships for over 30 years.
